hero.title: You keep the last word
hero.lede: Over your limit, nothing moves until you say so. The order, the customer's words and the rule that stopped it are all on one card.

cameToPerson.title: What came to a person on the test day
cameToPerson.lede: Three of the 21 conversations needed someone, and each arrived with the work already done.

items.title: A $1,444 refund
items.text: Over the $300 limit, so it waited for one click

items.title: An angry customer after hours
items.text: Told when the team is back, first in line in the morning

items.title: A question nobody had written down
items.text: Handed over and logged as a gap

decide.title: Change it, or say no
lede: Approve it, change the amount or decline. If you approve, the refund is recorded and the customer gets a confirmation.

image.alt: A refund approved by the owner, and the customer told.

owners.title: Most days the amber lamps are the whole job
owners.lede: Agents do the repeat work, and you decide the handful of things that need someone who owns the place.

image.alt: Two smiling shop owners standing behind their counter.

setLimit.title: Set the limit yourself
lede: Drag it and watch the same four orders from the test day change hands.
